title: Messages
empty: No conversations yet — accept a connection request to start one.

thread.sessionNote: A private session. Leave it, or stay quiet for 30 minutes, and everything here is deleted for both of you. A browser cannot stop screenshots, so write what you would say in person.
thread.familyNote: The families’ conversation. Everyone in both Home Circles can read it, and it is kept for as long as the two of you are connected.
thread.bringFamiliesHint: Open a chat with both families
thread.blockConfirm: Block {{name}}? They will not see you or message you again, and this chat closes.
thread.reportNote: This chat, as it is right now, goes to Mangaly’s safety team with your report. {{name}} is not told who reported.
thread.reportSent: Thank you. Our safety team will look at this.
thread.directNote: Your conversation, kept like any chat. Only the two of you can read it.
thread.endSessionHint: Deletes everything here for both of you
thread.starter2: Hi {{name}}, your profile made me smile
thread.starter3: What does a perfect Sunday look like for you?

error.network: We couldn't reach Mangalya. Check your connection and try again.
error.notAvailable: You can only message a connection you've both accepted.
error.rateLimited: You're sending messages too quickly. Please slow down.

system.connected: You are connected. Only the two of you can read this conversation.
system.family_opened: The families’ chat is open. Everyone in both Home Circles can read it.

list.noContacts: No one to message yet. People appear here once they are in your Home Circle, or in the family of someone you are connected with.
list.whoCanNote: You can message your own family, and the family of anyone you are connected with. Two connected candidates talk in their private session instead.
list.emptyBody: Write to someone in your family, or to the family of a match you are connected with.
list.pickBody: Choose a conversation, or start a new one.
